product.name: Apple 85W MagSafe 1 Charger
product.full_name: Genuine 85W MagSafe Power Adapter for MacBook Pro 15" / 17"
product.description: Genuine Apple power adapter (Model A1343, Apple Part No. MC556LL/A) for MacBook Pro 15-inch and 17-inch models with the original MagSafe (MagSafe 1) magnetic connector, made from 2006 up to Mid 2012 (non-Retina). 18.5V, 4.6A, 85W output. Because it is the highest-wattage MagSafe 1 adapter, it can also safely charge the 13-inch MacBook Pro and MacBook with MagSafe 1, which only draw what they need. Not compatible with the thinner MagSafe 2 connector used on Retina MacBook Pro and MacBook Air models from 2012 onward. Includes the detachable AC wall plug. Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Original Apple unit, tested before dispatch.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry
